compiler_binary64_helpers.scope: __aeabi_* plus eq/ne/ge/gt/le/lt df2 aliases; excludes project subtraction wrapper, clz and switch helper

findings.finding: Same-address alias removal alone is insufficient: cdrcmple 32 B at 0x10003004 shares its final 16 B with cdcmpeq/cdcmple at 0x10003014. The union is 32 B, not 48 B. Compiler helpers are 4746 B; adding the separate 16 B project subtraction wrapper gives 4762 B.

The audit assigns overlapping halfwords to the first nm size-ordered extent. Individual counted_text_B ownership in that tail is conventional; physical union is invariant. Exact-name aliases are grouped correctly. Twenty unowned bytes remain counted in total.

DWARF leaf attribution counts every halfword including padding/literals and may credit padding to the preceding source function. It partitions physical bytes but is not causal marginal code cost. reset 3856 B includes 1450 B stream_row plus other inlined work; reset leaf is only 182 B. Never add inline and physical-symbol totals.

audit.py discovers allocated candidates by an SRAM address range rather than SHF_ALLOC and iterates original sections only. Direct independent ELF parsing verified the exact alloc set for this image. A reusable/general audit should compare both complete alloc-section sets and reject odd symbol boundaries before halfword accounting.

candidate_questions.question: Test explicitly shared full/projected basis and derivative primitives across feature and transported; compare complete linked image and scratch. Leaf totals show where to inspect, not predicted savings. Preserve endpoint full-bank transport and derivative/scaling semantics.

Consider compact common update helpers for repeated free/forced response and H-jet logic, with exact or bounded rounding analysis. Do not replace variable-dt propagation with a fixed 35 Hz transition.

Explore a shared rotation/update kernel with storage access kept specialized. Packed-history rounding on every write and finite-check/quarantine behavior must survive; adding abstraction can increase code.
